messages:
Cheng: heads-up — staging enr workers OOMed on a few wide traces. culprit looks like we materialize a per-span enrichment map before fanout. one trace ~11k spans and heap went through the roof.

Maria: yikes. can you paste the small heaptrace/snippet? is the map keyed by span id or by resource?

Cheng: repro snippet in staging logs: we build a map(span_id -> enrich_result) then fanout joins. big traces -> big map.

Alex: proposal: bifurcate cheap vs heavy enrichment. gateway/edge sets lightweight claims (cohort, region, routing_key). central does heavy joins (billing metadata, account joins). saves lookups and memory.

Sam: totally, but trust boundary matters. edge claims must be authenticated. recommend short-lived HMAC token signed by control plane; central verifies and accepts cheap path.

Jamal: agree. also add provenance flags so downstream can know whether the cohort came from edge or central compute.

Cheng: rough envelope idea:
```
{
  "trace_id": "...",
  "spans": [...],
  "meta": {
    "x-enrich-v": "1",
    "x-cohort": "enterprise-A",
    "x-cohort-scope": "trace",
    "x-region": "eu-west-1",
    "x-cohort-sig": "hmac:..."
  }
}
```
Edge only sets small meta fields + sig. central verifies sig and either accepts or falls back.

Maria: signature approach sounds right. HMAC + key rotation + TTL. if verify fails -> central queues trace for full enrich and marks for reconciliation.

Sam: implementation detail: enr-worker should avoid building full map when span_count large. switch to stream-mode if spans > 2k: process spans in sliding windows, emit enriched fragments, and keep minimal index (hash -> provenance) for rehydration if needed.

Alex: SDK note: sign only the small envelope fields, not whole payload. short TTL (minutes) and rotate keys frequently. also expose an opt-in test flag for our account.

Jamal: streaming reduces peak memory but breaks some billing rules that expect trace-level cohort. we need precedence rules: edge-trace-signed > central-computed > streaming-default, and add enrich.prov metadata on spans.

Cheng: tradeoffs summary we can put in RFC: memory (stream wins), latency (edge reduces lookups), accuracy (trace-level wins), security (needs sigs), ops complexity (streaming complicates analytics).

Maria: rollout plan idea: 1) RFC for envelope + signing (Cheng) 2) gateway SDK patch (Alex) 3) staging canary with stream-mode (Maria) 4) enr-worker guard + backpressure + enrich.warning tag (Sam) 5) reconciliation topic & sampled audit events (Jamal).

obs-bot: deploy-bot: enr-worker v2 deployed to staging (rev: 2024-11-08_09a)

Sam: add an alert/metric: enrich.path = {edge-verified|streamed|full} and enrich.warning when we switched to stream-mode; also emit trace_span_count gauge.

Jamal: add a billing-recon topic: central emits sampled recon events (0.1%) comparing edge cohort vs central resolution so finance can detect misattribution.

Maria: tests: synthetic wide-trace load test for memory, correctness tests for reconciliation path, and analytics diff tests for streaming fragments.

Cheng: I'll draft RFC today with sample traces and compatibility matrix. aiming for a small staging canary next week. ping me if you want samples to attach. :thumbsup:
